Objective: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1250417 (Potassium/sodium hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel 4), including assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value, ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.

Output: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value

Source: activities, assays, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, target_dictionary

Logic: Filter activities where standard_relation = '=' and pchembl_value is not null, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, join target_dictionary to molecule_dictionary on molregno, join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, filter target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1250417', ensure assay_type = 'B' (Binding) or assay_type = 'F' (Functional) or assay_type = 'A' (ADME) or assay_type = 'P' (Physicochemical) or assay_type = 'T' (Toxicity) or assay_type = 'U' (Unassigned), order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, limit 1000.
